pretreatments.description: Heat treatment was applied to waste activated sludge at 102 °C for 30 min to increase hydrolysis and inhibit methanogenic microorganisms, reducing methanogenic inhibition.
Alkali pretreatment was conducted by adding 4 M NaOH to maintain pH at 10 during digestion to facilitate hydrolysis-acidification while suppressing methanogenic activity.
Concentration by settling for 24 h was performed on the waste sludge before use to clarify the sample and prepare it for digestion analysis.
